verification.","key_points":["Iven Pell isolated Press 4 after the interlock failed [C001]","The 2 March log records that PERSON_1 PERSON_1 restarted Press 4 after Iven Pell had isolated it [C010, C001]","PERSON_1 PERSON_1 signed the Press 4 safety inspection as complete on 4 March 2026 [C002]","The checklist for that inspection reports a 0.18-second stop on all four cycles [C003]","The issue register indicates the handheld meter was in calibration stores that morning [C004]","The packet reviewed contains no injury report [C005]","The production schedule shows a customer rush order but does not authorize skipping the test [C006]","Two days after the 4 March sign-off, PERSON_1 PERSON_1 instructed maintenance to copy February's guard-test readings into the March sheet [C007, C002]","In early April, PERSON_1 approved a replacement interlock for Press 4 [C008]","After the audit, Iven Pell photographed the unsealed test terminal [C009]","A green sticker alone does not establish that a functional test happened [C012]"],"risk_notes":["The documented instruction to copy prior readings and the documented unavailability of the handheld meter raise questions about the reliability of the recorded 0.18-second stop times, though intent is not established in the records","The rush order context is documented but explicitly does not authorize skipping tests, leaving uncertainty about operational pressures","Reporter allegations that the guard failed to stop the press and that isolation was reported to the day lead remain unverified and are not corroborated by independent documented evidence"],"limitations":["No independent documented evidence verifies the reporter allegations that the guard failed to stop the press or that the checklist was saved due to identical readings","The evidence does not show whether a functional test actually occurred on 4 March 2026, only what was recorded and that the meter was logged as elsewhere","No injury report is present in the packet, which is an absence of documentation and not evidence of absence of an incident","Several dates are imprecise or unresolved, including the exact date of the initial isolation and the audit, limiting precise sequencing beyond the documented 2 March and 4 March entries"]}
